components.css: .ds-nav{height:64px;display:flex;gap:36px;padding:0 48px;background:rgb(9 12 20 / 94%);border-bottom:1px solid #252a38;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font:14px Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;color:#bfc8df;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:#fff}.ds-nav a[aria-current]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:2px;background:#bc55ff}.ds-nav a:hover{color:#ddaeff}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #d190ff;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Featured card
components.description: Translucent preview surface with whole-card focus and hover.

narrative.overview: This refresh applies to the Markets route and shared header only. It pairs compact financial content with a near-black ground and static violet atmosphere. Other route bodies retain the legacy reference below. The approved surface brief is `.impeccable/markets.md`; product and data constraints remain in `PRODUCT.md`.
dos: Do preserve the scoped Markets palette, compact density and visible keyboard focus.
Do keep the shared header offset consistent across every route.
donts: Don't apply this refresh to other route bodies without a separate decision.
Don't animate the orbital artwork continuously or replace unavailable data with decorative charts.
